implementation_binding_note: The treatment census, metrics and acceptance were frozen at frozen_at_revision. The probe hash was added after an exploratory discarded validation and before the create-only formal measurement.
objective: Measure the effect of eight declared interruption or duplicate-delivery conditions against the same uninterrupted persisted workflow fixture.

fixture.runtime: Python 3.12 with PostgreSQL/pgvector and official PostgreSQL checkpoints
fixture.model: controlled typed substitute with fixed usage counters; no provider quality claim
fixture.tools: controlled read-only ports with immutable Evidence persistence
fixture.recovery: typed rollback fixture through deterministic verifier; no real human approval claim
fixture.isolation: fresh database identities and output directory per arm; Ground Truth is never mounted

control.description: The complete fixture runs without an injected interruption and records the same ledger and resource counters.

treatments.injection: Stop after the durable claim and before external dispatch.
Stop after dispatch when the result is unknown.
Stop after a typed model or tool result is committed and before graph transition.
Stop after one parallel read is committed and before its peer completes.
Replace the worker and checkpoint client at a durable graph boundary.
Expire the first worker lease and permit one replacement claim.
Return the declared timeout from one bounded external read.
Deliver the same operation identity concurrently twice.

reporting.comparisons: Every row contains control, treatment, absolute delta and relative delta when the control denominator is nonzero.
reporting.latency: Monotonic elapsed time; report all eight pairs and paired median delta with a 95% bootstrap interval.
reporting.safety: Zero duplicate external effects and zero ambiguous-result redispatches are mandatory.
reporting.cost: Rate-card upper bound is descriptive and must never be called actual billing.
reporting.failures: Failed or timed-out arms remain in the fixed census and are never selectively rerun.
